name: Steven Horsford

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "A woman's right to make her own health care decisions, including safe & legal abortion, is essential. We cannot allow these hard-fought protections, or any others, to be denied by an ideologically driven court or ultra conservative Congress. The time to fight is now."
Rated 100% by Planneds Parenthood Action Fund
Voted in favor of HR 8296 "Women's Health Protection Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 8297 "Ensuring Access to Abortion Act of 2022"

evidence.text: "FDR signed the Social Security Act 85 years ago today. This program is now under attack from the current administration. I will fight to protect Social Security so that all Nevadans can stay above the poverty fold, particularly with the economic challenges of this pandemic."

"Stevens been working in congress to expand Social Security benefits. He joined House Ways and Means Social Security Subcommittee Chairman John B. Larson (D-CT-01) to introduce the Social Security 2100 Act, groundbreaking legislation that will increase Social Security benefits for seniors and keep the system strong for generations to come."
Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "9 minutes and 29 seconds...There’s no excuse for police brutality. Pass the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act to keep public safety integral. We are long over due for transformative legislation to hold bad police accountable."

"One year ago today, George Floyd was killed. Although his murderer was convicted, we need more. Americans deserve legislation that protects them from police brutality nationally. The Senate needs to pass the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act and prove that Black Lives Matter."

"We must continue to push for the fair treatment of Black women and men under the law. I'm proud to be working toward a more equitable future with Congresswoman Dina Titus and Rep. Susie Lee with the Policing bill we've co-sponsored. I will not let this moment come and go in vain."
Voted in favor of HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 7521: "Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act"

"There are broader concerns with social media that we need to act on. The greatest threat to our democracy and electoral process is the proliferation of misinformation and disinformation. Viral statements and messages have gone unchecked on many of these platforms, steering public sentiment and suppressing democratic participation or altering the way a person may vote or act. And the algorithms that make up the backbone of many of these platforms could have broader implications when they don’t account for ethnic, racial, and cultural differences in their users."
